questions.title: How much should a prepaid card be authorized for?
questions.question: Checkout currently authorizes only half the goods as a hold on prepaid cards. With no surcharge on prepaid, should we keep that half-goods hold, or authorize the full goods amount? For example, $80 of goods on a prepaid card would be authorized for $40 or $80.

options.label: Authorize the full goods amount, no surcharge
options.clarification: Prepaid cards are authorized for the full goods amount with no surcharge; the existing half-goods hold is replaced.

options.label: Keep the existing half-goods hold, no surcharge
options.clarification: Prepaid cards keep the existing hold of half the goods amount (rounded down to the cent), with no surcharge added.
